tweet.text:
I’m working very hard to see if _human_ review can be obviated. My strategy is to institute many different forms of mechanical and agentic review. 

My working hypothesis is that such non-human reviews will be sufficient for a broad category of projects.  https://x.com/plainionist/status/2086683291592093739?s=12&t=BNL0r_QCoHPspP2GKupxGw
